blocks.text: Why earning 8% increment means you are actually getting poorer.
CPI measures price changes across a defined consumer basket. Your personal inflation depends on your household’s spending mix and may differ from headline CPI.
⚠️ Your household’s costs can rise at a different pace from headline CPI; track your own spending to estimate your personal inflation.
Savings-account rates vary by bank and account. Use your current rate.
Inflation varies by period and by household spending mix. Use a stated assumption in the calculator.
Real return depends on the account rate, inflation period, taxes, and fees.
Equity returns are uncertain. Use a clearly labelled assumption, not a promised index return.
Inflation: use the same stated assumption
Investment outcomes vary, and a positive real return is not guaranteed.

summary: Learn how inflation affects purchasing power, why personal costs differ from headline CPI, and how to compare savings and investment assumptions.
title: Inflation Reality
